deadline.value: Recommended deadline for Fall graduate assistantship consideration is February 1.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.

entry_route.value: Students may enter directly from a bachelor's or bypass the M.S. for a Ph.D.
entry_route.quote: Students wishing to bypass the M.S. for a Ph.D. must complete the same 24 hours of course work in Cell and Molecular Biology-approved course work as for the M.S. degree, plus a minimum of 18 hours of dissertation research.
